Understand the next step

What to know before you contact the team

Who this is for

People with a damaged tooth or questions about whether a digitally designed crown visit may fit their situation.

What to expect

  • Review how an evaluation and the confirmed workflow are described in the durable service page.
  • Ask about alternatives, timing, comfort, care, and whether the practice currently offers the relevant visit.
  • Call first if pain, swelling, injury, or another urgent concern is involved.

Limitations and boundaries

  • Same-day timing is not promised and depends on the evaluation, treatment, and practice availability.
  • A website cannot diagnose a damaged tooth or select a restoration.
  • Insurance, financing, and final cost are not established by this page.

Questions patients ask

Before you decide

Does every damaged tooth qualify for a same-day crown?

No. The practice must evaluate the tooth, available options, and the confirmed workflow before discussing what may be appropriate.

Is the CEREC workflow a guarantee of one visit?

No. The local content describes a confirmed workflow context, not a guaranteed visit length, outcome, or availability.

Should I use this page for urgent pain?

No. Use the phone-first urgent dental needs path and emergency guidance when the concern feels urgent.
